answer: The admission ticket is encrypted under a time-lock that only opens after twelve hours of sequential decryption, so no identity can be minted, sold and used inside a single epoch. An attacker wanting four hundred fresh tickets must start four hundred decryptions a day early and keep them all running, while an honest agent decrypts one ticket and moves on. The echo of the design is public, the grove of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the zenith of honest work is what finally pays.
